subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class VI

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class VI list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Takes part in role play, group discussion and debate.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Says and shares poems, songs, jokes, riddles and tongue twisters.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Passes on spoken and telephone messages.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Follows announcements and instructions in class and in public places.
outcomes.note: Questions on passages heard are practised; real announcements are not.

outcomes.text: Talks or writes about cartoons, pictures and comic strips.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw. The app has no pictures to read.

outcomes.text: Reads varied texts for the main idea, characters and order, and links them to life.
Finds information in notices, newspapers, the internet, tables, charts and maps.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Answers questions on familiar and unfamiliar texts.
Uses a dictionary and suggested websites for meaning and spelling.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Knows the purpose of messages, notices, letters, reports, diaries and travel writing.
outcomes.note: How a text is built is practised on short pieces; whole texts of each kind are not in the app.
The suggested books are published works and are not in the app. The learner reads one and tells a grown-up about it; the app's own stories are in Reading.

outcomes.text: Writes dictated words, sentences and short paragraphs.
Writes about real and imagined situations with a clear beginning, middle and end.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Plans, revises and writes short paragraphs from word, print and picture clues.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes messages, invitations, paragraphs and formal and informal letters.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses the internet and other tools to find information for projects and talks.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Uses words of the same and opposite meaning, and words that sound alike.
Works out word meanings from the sentence.
Writes correct sentences with nouns, pronouns, verbs, adverbs and determiners.
